purpose: Evaluate whether source-only features can forecast substantial independently verifiable scientific progress, separately from exact resolution/refutation.

A_direct_resolution.definition: The frozen question receives an independently authenticated result that matches the source object, assumptions, intervention/comparator, endpoint and falsification condition within the prespecified 3-5 year window.
A_direct_resolution.positive: Exact resolution or refutation with primary full-text provenance.
A_direct_resolution.negative: Only when the complete outcome-acquisition protocol finds an authenticated primary record explicitly showing the frozen question remains false or is not resolved under the exact endpoint; search absence is missing.
A_direct_resolution.missing: No authenticated exact endpoint, incomplete retrieval, or endpoint mismatch.
A_direct_resolution.paper3_score_gate: At least 20 labeled questions, at least 5 positive and 5 negative labels, at least 3 question-family groups in every chronological evaluation split, and independent adjudication before any AUC/calibration estimate.

B_substantial_progress.definition: A dated primary source independently verifies at least one prespecified progress category for the frozen question without requiring exact full resolution.
positive_categories: verified new theorem or bound that directly narrows the frozen gap
verified algorithmic improvement against a matched baseline and endpoint
replicated empirical improvement on independent units with the same endpoint
independent counterexample to a frozen premise or claimed regime
premise refutation or revision with explicit scope and evidence
substantive narrowing of the open question with a changed falsification or parameter boundary
B_substantial_progress.negative: A completed, source-authenticated search and adjudication protocol finds no positive category in the frozen window and records sufficient coverage; this is not assigned from missing search hits.
B_substantial_progress.missing: Incomplete retrieval, no primary full text, unclear relation to the frozen question, or only publication/citation/topical similarity.
B_substantial_progress.independent_adjudication: Two provenance checks must agree on category, relation to source question, date, endpoint and exclusion of publication-count proxies.
B_substantial_progress.paper3_score_gate: At least 30 questions, at least 10 independently adjudicated positives and 10 verified no-progress/negative outcomes, at least 3 grouped chronological holdout blocks, and a frozen feature table. Otherwise report no-score with label counts.

source_selection.selection_window: source publication years 2010-2021; source versions frozen at each year-end
exclusions: publication or citation counts as outcomes
questions whose endpoint cannot be observed independently

allowed: historical field momentum computed only from earlier sources
baselines: publication volume only if computed point-in-time and not used as an outcome proxy

evaluation.split: chronological grouped holdout with untouched final period
metrics: ranking only if class gate passes
calibration only if prevalence and sample-size gate passes
evaluation.case_control_diagnostic: Permitted only as pipeline mechanics and explicitly excluded from unbiased forecast claims.

next_evidence_acquisition: Build the 40-row source-only cohort and pre-register follow-up retrieval before searching for outcomes; stop if the positive/negative class gates remain infeasible rather than expanding metadata indefinitely.
